name: Churchill Island

facts.claim: Churchill Island Heritage Farm sits off Phillip Island with historic grounds, daily farming activities and bay walking trails.
Walking and cycling trails are free to enjoy; the site has bird-watching huts and a cafe.
Highland cattle experience and wagon rides (weekends and holidays) are extras on top of entry.

access_note: Adult entry $17.50 from the Nature Parks page; the $80 Bandicoot Discovery Tour and $60 Highland Cattle Experience are separate extras. Farmers' market is a periodic event, not a spot.

name: Cape Woolamai

facts.claim: Cape Woolamai is Phillip Island's highest point, with views over a surf beach and walking tracks along wind- and wave-carved cliffs.
Walks range from 4 to 8 km, including a Pinnacles return reached from the beach.
Short-tailed shearwaters arrive here in late September after migrating from the Aleutian Islands; walks may be impassable on very high tides.

name: Phillip Island Grand Prix Circuit

facts.claim: The circuit hosts the world-leading motorsport series, including the WorldSBK round in February.
Circuit Viewing from the Visitor Centre water-gardens mound shows up to 80% of the track, including Stoner Corner and Siberia.
Circuit Viewing admission includes the History of Motorsport Display covering the island's racing since 1928.

name: National Vietnam Veterans Museum

facts.claim: Museum on Australia's involvement in the Vietnam War with multiple galleries on the war and the experiences of Australian veterans.
Has a gift shop, the Nui Dat Cafe and a Garden of Reflection.

name: Rhyll Inlet and Conservation Hill

facts.claim: Mangrove and mudflat wetlands on the north shore of Phillip Island, part of the Western Port Ramsar-listed wetland.
Boardwalks loop through mangroves and saltmarsh; spoonbills, oystercatchers, herons and migratory shorebirds feed here.
A 500 m return lookout walk climbs the Conservation Hill Observation Tower for views over the inlet and Western Port.
Mangrove boardwalk is 1.2 km return, about 45 minutes; trails start from the Conservation Hill car park on McIlwraith Rd.

name: Phillip Island Chocolate Factory

facts.claim: Retail shop and cafe have free entry; the ticketed Panny's Amazing World of Chocolate is an interactive factory tour with a chocolate waterfall.
Over 100 chocolate varieties are made on site.
Located at 930 Phillip Island Rd, Newhaven.
